extracted.intended_audience: NIH grant applicants, grantee institutions, institutional grants administrators, and NIH staff
extracted.subtask_description: Policy and procedural standards governing eligibility, application, award, administration, reporting, allowable costs, public policy requirements, and special program rules for NIH grants and cooperative agreements (effective Oct 1, 1998 budget periods).

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Who or which organizations are eligible to apply for NIH grants and cooperative agreements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appears under multiple sections (Part I, Part II, Part III) with program-specific eligibility rules (e.g., NRSA individual and institutional eligibility, awards to foreign institutions, grants to federal institutions, for-profit organizations, SBIR/STTR eligibility).

rubrics_metrics.name: Application and Review Processes
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and requirements governing submission, receipt, peer review, council review, appeals, and disposition of applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Application Submission, Application Forms, Table 1: Required Forms for Competing Applications, Application Receipt Points and Deadlines, The Peer Review Process (Initial Review; National Advisory Council or Board Review), Appeals of Initial Scientific Review, Disposition of Applications, and Sources of Information about NIH's grants process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of Applications and Support Mechanisms
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions and rules for different application types and funding/support mechanisms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers Types of Applications, Support Mechanisms, Funding Opportunities and program-specific application procedures (e.g., NRSA, construction grants, SBIR/STTR, consortium agreements).

rubrics_metrics.name: Application Receipt Points and Deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Designated receipt points and deadline requirements for submitting grant applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table of required forms and receipt/receipt dates are listed; late or misdirected applications may have legal implications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal Implication of Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Legal effects and implications of submitting an application to NIH.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes confidentiality, proprietary information handling and potential legal responsibilities tied to the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confidentiality of Information (Proprietary Information)
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies on confidentiality and handling of proprietary information submitted in applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cross-references FOIA/Privacy Act and describes how proprietary information is protected or disclosed under federal law.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer Review Process
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and procedures for scientific peer review of applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes initial review, advisory council/board review, and appeals of initial scientific review; establishes expectations for fairness and review criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding Principles
rubrics_metrics.description: General principles that govern NIH funding decisions and award-making.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appears in Part II as a broad policy framework setting priorities and procedures for funding decisions across programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of Grant Award
rubrics_metrics.description: The official document that notifies recipients of award decisions and specifies terms and conditions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies funding, budget, additional terms and conditions tied to the grant award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget and Cost Considerations
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies governing budget preparation, allowable costs, and financial considerations for grant-supported activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes The Cost Principles; Direct Costs and Facilities and Administrative (Indirect) Costs; Cost Transfers, Overruns, and Accelerated and Delayed Expenditures; Allocation of Costs and Closely Related Work; Applicable Credits; Services Provided by Affiliated Organizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowability of Costs/Activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Which costs and activities may be charged to NIH grant funds and which are unallowable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains Selected Items of Cost, Allowable Costs/Activities sections by program (e.g., construction, NRSA) and program-specific Unallowable Costs/Activities listings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment and Cash Management (SMARTLINK II/ACH, CASHLINE/ACH)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and systems for disbursement of grant funds and cash requests.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Monthly Cash Request procedures and rules for interest earned on advances of grant funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior Approval Requirements and Expanded Authorities
rubrics_metrics.description: Which changes in project, budget, or scope require NIH prior approval and which actions may be covered by expanded authorities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Requests for Approval, Noncompeting Continuation Awards, Streamlined Noncompeting Award Process, and detailed Prior Approval Requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Changes in Project and Budget
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies for when and how grantees must request approval for changes in project scope, budget reallocations, rebudgeting, and related matters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appears in Administrative Requirements and in program-specific sections (e.g., NRSA rebudgeting of funds).

rubrics_metrics.name: Program Income
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for program income generated under NIH grants and how it must be reported/used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Reporting of Program Income, Sale of Real Property/Equipment/Supplies, and program-specific treatment of income.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial Management System Standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards that financial management systems must meet to account for NIH funds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed under Management Systems and Procedures and includes requirements for accounting, reporting, and documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Property Management System Standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for managing real and personal property acquired under NIH grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Real Property, Equipment and Supplies, Exempt Property, Nonexempt Property, Revocable License, and rules for sale/disposition of property.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procurement System Standards and Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and requirements governing procurement under NIH awards, including contracting with small/minority/women-owned businesses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers General procurement rules, Approval Requirements, Contracting with Small Businesses/Minority-Owned/Women's Business Enterprises, and related monitoring and reporting obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Periodic and final reporting requirements for programmatic and financial progress under NIH awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Progress Reports as part of Noncompeting Continuation Requests, Financial Reports, Final Reports (Final Financial Status Report, Final Progress Report, Final Invention Statement and Certification), and special reporting like Invention Reporting and Report to the Office of Research Integrity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audit and Record Retention and Access
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for audits, record retention, and federal access to records supporting expenditures and program performance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Audit procedures, Record Retention and Access rules, and enforcement mechanisms arising from audit findings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enforcement Actions, Suspension, Termination, Recovery of Funds
rubrics_metrics.description: Actions NIH may take for noncompliance, including suspension, termination, withholding support, recovery of funds, debt collection, and other enforcement actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Modification of Terms of Award and Other Enforcement Actions; processes for recovery and debt collection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventions and Patents; Rights in Data and Unique Research Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies governing inventions, patents, copyrights, rights in data, unique research resources, and related reporting and royalties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Invention Reporting, Royalties and Licensing Fees from Copyrights/Inventions/Patents, Rights in Data (Publication and Copyrighting), Unique Research Resources, and Final Invention Statement and Certification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Subjects Protections
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements affecting the rights and welfare of individuals as research subjects, patients, or recipients of services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers Human Subjects protections, Confidentiality of Patient Records, Protection of Research Subjects' Identity, Investigational New Drug Applications, and related program assurances and requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion Policies (Women, Minorities, Children)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for inclusion of women and minorities and for inclusion of children in clinical research design.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Requirements for Inclusiveness in Research Design, Inclusion of Women and Minorities as Subjects in Clinical Research, and Inclusion of Children as Subjects in Clinical Research; program-specific implementation guidance appears in NRSA and other sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Animal Welfare
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies and requirements for humane care and use of vertebrate animals in research supported by NIH.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appears in Human Subjects/Animal Welfare/Recombinant DNA sections and program-specific sections; includes institutional animal welfare assurances and reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recombinant DNA and Institutional Biosafety Committees (IBCs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for institutional oversight, biosafety review, and compliance for recombinant DNA research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Recombinant DNA and IBC responsibilities and compliance expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflict of Interest
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies addressing financial and other conflicts of interest affecting NIH-funded research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed under Public Policy Requirements and Objectives; institutions must have policies to identify and manage conflicts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Debarment and Suspension
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and restrictions related to individuals or organizations that have been debarred or suspended from federal programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Institutions must ensure compliance and may be restricted from receiving funds if debarred/suspended.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drug-Free Workplace
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that grantees maintain a drug-free workplace as a condition of award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed under Public Policy Requirements and Objectives; includes obligations for grantee policies and actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lobbying Restrictions and Lobbying Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Prohibitions and disclosure requirements concerning lobbying activities funded by NIH awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Limitation on Use of Funds for Promotion or Legalization of Controlled Substances, Lobbying, and Lobbying Disclosure reporting requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Misconduct in Science; Report to the Office of Research Integrity (ORI)
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies for handling allegations of research misconduct and reporting obligations to ORI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes procedures for reporting, investigation, and institutional responsibilities related to misconduct in science.

rubrics_metrics.name: Civil Rights and Nondiscrimination Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Compliance with civil rights statutes (Age Discrimination Act, Civil Rights Act, Education Amendments of 1972, Rehabilitation Act of 1973) and related nondiscrimination obligations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Institutions receiving NIH funds must comply with federal civil rights and nondiscrimination laws as described.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environmental Impact and Construction-related Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: NEPA and other environmental, design, construction, and safety requirements for NIH-assisted construction and alteration/renovation projects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Public Policy Requirements and Objectives for construction grants, NEPA, Public Disclosure, Flood Insurance, Historic Properties and Archeological Sites, Intergovernmental Review (EO 12372), design standards (ASHRAE, Life Safety Code, plumbing/electrical codes), seismic safety, and other facility standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Construction Grants: Procurement and Labor Standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Procurement, labor standards, equal employment opportunity, contract work hours, liquidated damages and wage-related requirements for construction grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers Procurement Requirements for Construction Services, Construction Management Services, Design-Build Services, Equal Employment Opportunity, Non-Segregated Facilities, Labor Standards, Contract Work Hours and Safety Standards Act, Liquidated Damages, Disposition of Unclaimed Wages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Real Property Management Standards for Construction/Alteration Projects
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for use, disposition, appraisal, notice of federal interest, and insurance requirements for real property under NIH grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Real Property Management Standards, Use and Disposition, Real Estate Appraisals, Notice of Federal Interest, Insurance Requirements, and exhibits like Alteration and Renovation Cost Estimate Outline.

rubrics_metrics.name: National Research Service Awards (NRSA) Specific Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Program-specific rules for NRSAs including eligibility, degree requirements, citizenship, sponsorship, application/receipt dates, review, notification, period of support, initiation of support, payments, stipends, institutional allowances, tuition, reporting, payback obligations, and related policies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extensive subitems: Individual NRSAs (predoctoral/postdoctoral/senior fellows), Sponsorship (foreign sponsorship), NIH employees, payments (domestic/foreign), stipend levels and supplementation, allowable institutional costs by type of institution, reporting procedures (activation notice, payback agreements, termination notice), progress and financial reporting, leave, termination, publications, patents, human subjects/animal welfare/recombinant DNA requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support of Scientific Meetings (Conference Grants)
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies and requirements for NIH support of scientific meetings and conferences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Applicability, Definitions, Eligibility, Application, Public Policy Requirements, Review, Funding, Allowability of Costs/Activities, Administrative Requirements, Intellectual Property: Publications and Copyright, Reporting and Record Retention, Progress and Expenditure Reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consortium Agreements (Subawards/Consortium Participants)
rubrics_metrics.description: Administrative, financial, and programmatic requirements for consortium participants and contractors under NIH grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers General administrative requirements, public policy obligations, application of cost principles, approval authorities, tangible personal property, exempt/nonexempt property, intellectual property, program income, audit, and written agreements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awards to Foreign Institutions and Grants with Substantial Foreign Components
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligibility, review, public policy, funding/payment, allowability of costs, administrative requirements, changes in project and budget, change of grantee organization, and audit rules for foreign awardees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes program-specific guidance on foreign payment mechanisms, allowable activities, and administrative obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grants to Federal Institutions and Payments to Federal Employees
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligibility, payment, allowability of costs, administrative requirements, equipment accountability, procurement, and intellectual property rules when federal institutions or employees are grantees or contractors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies differences and special procedures for federal grantees and payments to/for federal employees under grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grants to For-Profit Organizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies for awarding grants to for-profit entities including allowability of costs, cost principles, profit or fee, IR&D costs, facilities and administrative costs, administrative requirements, and intellectual property rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes program-specific differences in cost allowability, profit considerations, and reporting obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) and Small Business Technology Transfer (STTR) Program Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligibility, public policy requirements, allowability of costs and fee/profit, facilities and administrative costs, administrative requirements, market research, program income, and intellectual property rights for SBIR/STTR awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers program-specific rules distinct from regular NIH grants, including commercialization and ownership requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting of Program Income, Royalties, and Licensing Fees
rubrics_metrics.description: How to report program income and revenues from royalties/licensing related to NIH-funded work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes rules for reporting and disposition of royalties and licensing fees from copyrights, inventions, and patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final Reports and Closeout Procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and procedures for closeout of NIH awards, including submission of final financial and progress reports and final invention statements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Final Financial Status Report, Final Progress Report, Final Invention Statement and Certification, Grant Appeals Procedures, and closeout timelines and obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant Appeals Procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures available to applicants/grantees to appeal award decisions or administrative actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appeals process is described under Part II closeout and grant appeals procedures; includes steps for pursuing administrative appeals.
